card.name: Linking words before clinical findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as been, or, is, until, early or common in the middle of a clinical statement. They sit right before the finding or condition is named, such as an effect, toxicity or poisoning.

modes.label: Has/also been
modes.description: The word been after has or also, just before a reported effect or association.
modes.example: Cocaine has<< been>> noted to cause spasm of the coronary

modes.label: Modifier before a condition
modes.description: A short modifier or conjunction such as or, early, common or special placed before a condition or treatment noun.
modes.example: Benzathine benzylpenicillin is not recommended in newborns with proven<< or>> highly probable congenital syphilis.
